confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from crowd-sourced aggregator snippets (Expatistan, Numbeo-style data, travel guides, venue menus) of mixed dates, not a current 2026 survey, so they are rough. Beer, coffee and inexpensive meals are the better-supported anchors; cocktail and wine are less certain and were cross-checked against the beer and bottle-price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July 2026 peak-summer window, with no accommodation search or live listing check. The FX observation is the 20 March 2026 RBA figure reported in search, not the latest RBA observation for the 2026-11-19 generation date, because I could not retrieve a later official value within the search limit. EUR-to-USD conversion uses roughly 1.15 USD per EUR, implied by aggregator snippets rather than an official rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tallinn-specific aggregator price data for restaurants, cafés, pubs and bars, cross-checked against typical Northern and Central European mid-sized capital price levels. Accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of Tallinn summer hostel and hotel rates.
